Dear ImGui - vendored dependency
================================
Upstream : https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
Tag      : v1.92.9b-docking
Commit   : b48d1afbe8ee8b238e2961dc363a949dd7304e23
#define IMGUI_VERSION       "1.92.9b"
#define IMGUI_VERSION_NUM   19291

Branch note
-----------
This is the 'docking' branch, which is where upstream ships multi-viewport and
docking support. IMGUI_HAS_DOCK and IMGUI_HAS_VIEWPORT are defined here and are
NOT defined on master, so any code guarded by them silently disappears if this
tree is ever swapped for a master build.

The upstream .git directory was intentionally removed: this is a frozen copy,
not a submodule, so a plain 'git clone' of Manifold-AccountManager is complete
and buildable with no extra steps.

To update: replace this directory with a fresh checkout of a newer *-docking
tag and update this file. Do not cherry-pick individual files.
